title: Beyond One World: Benchmarking Super Heros in Role-Playing Across Multiversal Contexts
reasoning: The paper features a core task called 'Moral Dilemmas' which evaluates how LLMs handle ethically charged scenarios based on a 'Moral Conflict Taxonomy' (e.g., Save One vs. Save the Greater Good, Ends Justify the Means vs. Moral Code). It tests models on their ability to reason through and act upon specific moral frameworks and ethical codes consistent with a character's canon.
